adaptive_disclosure: New portfolio-construction family over four previously researched sleeves. The underlying edges and 2018-2024 sample are touched; this is diagnostic, not clean OOS.

allocation_contract.information_lag: Weights on a rebalance date use source returns strictly before that date.
allocation_contract.volatility_input: Standalone source net returns under the same 4 bps trade, 1% borrow, and 2.5% financing conventions.
allocation_contract.warmup: Equal weight among the variant's allowed sources until minimum history exists.
allocation_contract.cap_algorithm: Normalize inverse volatility and iteratively redistribute weight above the fixed cap among uncapped sleeves.
allocation_contract.allocator_turnover: In addition to weighted source turnover, charge sum(abs(weight change) times average prior/current source gross exposure). No cross-sleeve netting credit.

development_selection.baseline: Recompute fixed 75% pairs / 25% calendar at 1.0x in the same union-calendar engine.
development_selection.rank: Higher development Calmar, then CAGR, then Sharpe, then variant name.

stopping_rule: If no dynamic variant beats the lead's development Calmar under all gates, or the one selected row fails touched validation, kill this allocator family without parameter refinement.
post_run_implementation_correction: Before final reporting, zero-weight source ticker rows were removed from ticker-count reporting. They carried exactly zero PnL, so this changes no return, drawdown, cost, concentration share, gate, rank, or selection; the script was re-hashed and outputs were overwritten.
